appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'
Four colored segments representing energy sources with percentage labels.

printed_facts.fact: Nuclear source accounts for 45% of global energy consumption.
Hydroelectric source accounts for 10% of global energy consumption.
Fossil Fuels source accounts for 30% of global energy consumption.
Renewables source accounts for 15% of global energy consumption.

public_definitions: The goal is to identify the largest global energy consumption source category from the dashboard and route that source record to priority source monitoring.
The chart is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source' and displays four categories with their respective percentages.
The routing options are: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring, Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring, Keep Fossil Fuels on routine source monitoring.
The routing criterion is 'Largest global energy consumption category'.
